Moodles_OperationAcorn:sixth_desc_lvl1: A feeling that an unseen zombie is close.
Moodles_OperationAcorn:biteShield_desc_l: Almost recovered. Until then, a bite would infect you.
Less than half the recovery is left. A bite now would infect you.
More than half the recovery is left. A bite now would infect you.
Used up by a bite you shrugged off; it takes days to recover. A bite now would infect you.
Moodles_OperationAcorn:suppressed_desc_l: A delay drug holds the infection back for a day or less more. A new wound from a zombie ends it.
A delay drug holds the infection back for up to 3 more days. A new wound from a zombie ends it.
A delay drug holds the infection back for up to 5 more days. A new wound from a zombie ends it.
A delay drug holds the infection back for up to 7 more days. A new wound from a zombie ends it.
Moodles_OperationAcorn:untested_desc_lvl: A wound from a zombie that has not been tested for infection. Until it is, 30%% of each delivery goes to the infection handling fee.
Moodles_OperationAcorn:adapting_desc_lvl: Your body is adapting to the serum you took. The enhancement point comes when it is over.
